svg.title: How monet works. You and Claude build a change. Type /monet:review-local to review it before you push. It runs paint, which draws the review, and you fix the findings and review again. Type /monet:ship to commit and open the PR. It runs git-draft-commit and git-draft-pr, which use voice so the text reads like you. Type /monet:teach to understand what landed. Solid boxes are commands you type. Dashed boxes are skills that monet runs for you.

g.text: draft the commit and the PR
